قِصَاصٌ : see قُصَاص. ＝
-A2- Also, (S, M, Msb, K,) and ↓ قَصَاصَآءُ , (so in a copy of the M, and in the CK, and in a MS copy of the K [in the TA ↓ قُصَاصَآءُ , which I think a mistake,]) and ↓ قِصَاصَآءُ , (M, K,) [the first an inf. n. of 3, q. v.,] i. q. قَوَدٌ; (S, K;) Retaliation, by slaying for slaying, and wounding for wounding, (M, Msb, TA,) and mutilating for mutilating. (Msb.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
